name: M3 Voron heat-set insert (CNC Kitchen M3 x 5 x 4)
summary: Brass insert melted into a printed part. Needs a 4.4 mm hole at least 5 mm deep.
source: CNC Kitchen metric insert table: M3 x 4 is 4 mm long and 5 mm across the knurl, wants a 4.4 mm hole at least 5 mm deep and at least 1.6 mm of plastic around the hole. This is the size the Voron printers are designed around. Other brands of the same nominal size differ by a few tenths, so test-fit one before printing a whole enclosure.
